alex: hypothetical poll: if you could have one very specific, slightly silly superpower at work, what would it be? short answers! :sparkles:
rina: instant tab-finder  (I can never find the right browser tab) :mag:
orion: 30-second meeting mute  auto-summarize the whole thing when it ends :stopwatch:
sofia: coffee-replenish aura  everyones mug is refilled when empty :coffee:
leo: ctrl-z for deployed code  undo prod mistakes like they never happened :backhand_index_pointing_right:
alex: :thinking_face: also bonus: name your power in two words
rina: Tab-Finder (obvious but life-changing)
orion: Meeting Whisper (summarize + TL;DR)
sofia: Infinite Refill
leo: Rollback Wand
design-bot: Fun idea: we could make tiny pixel icons for these powers if y'all vote. :art:
ops-bot: Reminder: no literal magic allowed in infra. Please file a feature request instead :robot_face:
alex: Ha. Quick poll: react with one emoji to vote for your favorite power (only pick one): 
  mag: Tab-Finder  stopwatch: Meeting Whisper  
  :coffee: Infinite Refill  :backhand_index_pointing_right: Rollback Wand
rina: :mag:
orion: :stopwatch: (obviously)
sofia: :coffee: 
leo: :backhand_index_pointing_right: 
alex: Results so far: Tab-Finder 1, Meeting Whisper 1, Infinite Refill 1, Rollback Wand 1. Tiebreaker: which one would you pay $5/month for as a browser extension?
sofia: Infinite Refill   (happy to pay for bottomless good coffee)
rina: Tab-Finder   (I would pay more for this)
orion: Meeting Whisper  (especially if it produced good action items)
leo: Rollback Wand   (dev nightmares saved)
alex: Love it. Consensus: we're all tired and need different magic. Thanks for playing! If anyone wants to mock up icons, tag @design and @ops for sticker/extension feasibility. :tada:
